# Wave 2 Debian packaging repair

## Status

Source packaging repair is complete and ready for publication and independent review. The final targeted verification passed all eight tests in 4.451 seconds. No Git commits, staging, resets, or pushes were performed by this agent. The parent owns the separate binary build failure and is retrieving its bounded diagnostics.

## Confirmed cause

Darling CI run `42323661071`, source job `128255470003`, failed with Debian's actual diagnostic:

> cannot build with source format '3.0 (quilt)': non-native package version does not contain a revision

The old generated version was `0.1.20261107~resolute`. The packaging scripts now generate an upstream version `0.1.YYYYMMDD` and a Debian revision `1~DISTRO`, producing `0.1.YYYYMMDD-1~DISTRO`. The orig tarball is named using the upstream version only. The workflow's former distro glob would omit that corrected orig filename, so collection was repaired at the same time.

Evidence: https://github.com/boop-bip80/LINUX-LOGIC-PRO/actions/runs/42323661071/job/128255470003 and the prior local audit `w1_ci_audit.md`.

## Exact owned changed files

- `tools/debian/package-common.sh` (new): shared daily version, changelog, and orig archive generation. The upstream archive excludes top-level Debian packaging and Git metadata, including submodule `.git` files.
- `tools/debian/make-deb`: uses the common version logic, retains the binary/source build flags, and rejects invalid arguments before mutating the changelog. Adds side-effect-free CLI help.
- `tools/debian/ppa-build-source`: uses the same corrected source version/orig naming and retains its source-only build semantics. Removes the duplicated `-S` and validates CLI arguments.
- `tools/debian/collect-source-artifacts` (new, executable): derives exact filenames from the changelog and requires the orig archive, Debian archive, DSC, source changes, and source buildinfo before moving any files. Rejects revisionless versions and incorrect CLI argument counts.
- `tests/compat/logic-pro/build/test_debian_packaging.py` (new): eight synthetic-fixture tests covering real quilt source creation/extraction, binary flags, CLI argument handling, complete collection, missing-artifact failure before moves, and invalid version handling.
- `.github/workflows/actions.yaml`: runs the packaging tests in `build-dsc`, invokes the collector, and makes an empty source upload an error. No runner, compiler, concurrency, binary build, or original source archive job settings changed.

## Validation

Final command, run from the repository root:

```sh
python3 -u -B -m unittest discover -s tests/compat/logic-pro/build -p 'test_debian_packaging.py' -v
```

Result: **8 tests passed**, exit 0, 4.451 seconds.

The fixture substitutes only the clock and devscripts wrappers. Its source wrapper invokes the installed `/usr/bin/dpkg-buildpackage` with `-S -d -us -uc`; `dpkg-source`, source-format checks, source artifact generation, and extraction are real. A temporary empty but valid dpkg status database is passed through `--admindir`, avoiding dependence on this container's absent `/var/lib/dpkg/status`. This fixes the reviewer's initially observed local `dpkg-genbuildinfo` failure without skipping or fabricating source builds. The binary test verifies CLI flags; it does not claim a compiled binary package.

Additional successful checks:

```sh
sh -n tools/debian/make-deb tools/debian/ppa-build-source tools/debian/package-common.sh tools/debian/collect-source-artifacts
git diff --check -- .github/workflows/actions.yaml tools/debian/make-deb tools/debian/ppa-build-source tools/debian/package-common.sh tools/debian/collect-source-artifacts tests/compat/logic-pro/build/test_debian_packaging.py
```

## Remaining integrated verification

The full repository source and binary builds still need the next published GitHub Actions candidate. The independent source fixture validates the known source-format defect; it does not establish a full repository build pass or a Phase 4 pass. The prior binary job `128255469767` also failed. Its full log exceeded 780,000 lines and connector retrieval closed the transport; the parent has a separate bounded readback workflow in progress. No binary cause was guessed and no unsupported compiler/runner changes were made.

All implementation and test fixtures were written for this repair from the repository's packaging interface and observed dpkg behavior. No third-party or restricted Apple implementation source was used.
